items.say: Hello. I'm Moss. We're going to do some breathing. You're already good at the basic version.
text: Breathe in for 4, then out slowly for 8.
A long, slow out-breath is the body's own way of easing off. Your heartbeat settles a touch with each one, and your shoulders tend to follow.
No need to get it perfect. If 8 feels long, breathe out as slowly as is comfortable.

items.say: This one is called 5, 4, 3, 2, 1. It's counting, but nicer.
text: When your head is busy, your senses are a quiet way back to the room you're in.
Notice 5 things you can see, 4 you can hear, 3 you can touch, 2 you can smell and 1 you can taste.
Tap a bubble for each thing you notice. Nothing to type, and nothing counts as wrong. If a smell won't turn up, move on: that's allowed.

items.say: A body scan. We visit each part of you and say hello. Very polite.
text: We start at your feet and move slowly up to the top of your head.
At each place, just notice how it feels: warm, heavy, tight, nothing much. Then let it soften, if it wants to.
Sit or lie however is comfortable. Eyes closed is fine; the words change as we move.

senses.hint: Something near, something far, something small.
Close sounds, then the ones further off.
Your clothes, the chair, the air on your skin.
Even a faint one counts. So does just air.
Whatever is there, or just your own mouth.

zones.name: Feet
zones.line: Start with your feet. Notice where they touch the floor.

zones.name: Legs
zones.line: Up to your legs. Let them be heavy.

zones.name: Hips
zones.line: Your hips. Let the seat hold you.

zones.name: Belly
zones.line: Your belly. Let it rise and fall on its own.

zones.name: Chest
zones.line: Your chest. Just notice the breath moving.

zones.name: Hands and shoulders
zones.line: Your hands and shoulders. Let the shoulders drop a little.

zones.name: Jaw and face
zones.line: Your jaw and face. Unclench, soften round the eyes.

zones.name: Top of the head
zones.line: And the top of your head. That's all of you.
